titulo: Your Tax Shielding & Regularization in 3 Clear Steps
descripcion: Sorting out your tax status with SUNAT does not have to be overwhelming. At Estudio Cusihuaman, we apply a technical, rigorous, and preventive methodology backed by former public tax audit experience.
paso_1_desc: We audit your SUNAT SOL mailbox, verify electronic fee receipts (RHE), check 4th & 5th category withholdings, and cross-reference ITF banking records.
paso_2_desc: We file timely withholding suspensions (Form 1609), plan maximum 7+3 UIT deductible allowances, and rectify inconsistencies before an audit notice arrives.
paso_3_desc: We submit your annual income tax returns to SUNAT, claim legitimate tax refunds on credit balances, and secure your long-term peace of mind.
